blocks.text:
Breakfast. Explore the Brazilian side of Iguazu Falls with an English-speaking guide. Viewpoints in the national park overlook the cascades and forested banks. The name Iguazu means “big water”: the calm river above the falls gives way to torrents plunging into the gorge.

You can add the Macuco Safari, Bird Park or a helicopter flight at an additional cost. Prices differ between the day description and the appendix; the final rate is confirmed before payment.

blocks.text: The Macuco Safari is optional on this tour: $135 per person in the day programme and $130 per person in the appendix. Travel about 3 km through the jungle in an open jeep with a guide, then continue on foot and by motorboat close to the falls. The current rate is confirmed when you book.
